name: Timed Up and Go Test
description: Patient rises from a standard arm chair, walks 3 meters, turns, walks back, and sits down. Time in seconds; lower is better.
shirleySays: ICC 0.92–0.99 (elderly). MDC: 2.9 s (elderly), 3.5 s (PD). MCID: ~3 s convention. Normative means: 60–69 yr ≈8.1 s; 70–79 yr ≈9.2 s; 80–89 yr ≈11.3 s. Validated in elderly, PD, stroke, TBI, SCI, MS, amputation. Sensitivity/specificity 87% for fall risk in elderly.

scoring.mcidNote: ~3 s convention; MDC 2.9 s in community-dwelling elderly
